name: time-log
description: Timer and timesheet reports over a plaintext file on your own machine.
long_description: Start and stop a timer, log time after the fact, and ask for totals by client, project, or period. Entries are one JSON object per line in a file you own and can read, grep, or back up — nothing is stored on anyone else's server.

data_dir.title: Where to keep your time log
data_dir.description: Entries are written to entries.jsonl in this folder. Pick a synced folder if you want it backed up.
